include: selected current landing index.html pages from canonical implementation
exact 32 route-backed account snapshots from release latest-routes.json
recursive local HTML/CSS/JS/image/font/media dependencies referenced by those pages
package index, manifests, contracts, verifier and QA receipts
exclude: Figma caches/raw exports not referenced by the selected closure
temporary, backup, duplicate and QA-only pages
backend PHP/Yii2 application code, databases, logs, cookies, tokens and runtime dumps
unselected root-level HTML and fixture pages unless a selected page directly requires them

routePolicy.homeHtml: rewrite to site/index.html; source home.html is legacy/alternate and is not copied

claimCeiling: local route/link/resource and responsive QA evidence recorded in proof/
no backend authentication, billing, realtime, persistence, owner authority or production readiness claim
